# Supplement A {#app:S}



```{r process,echo=F,include=F}
# This will be the meta data really...
# remove columns we don't need.
loc <- "D:/GitHub/ICM/"
what.2.tune <- 'fec_nm'
library(csasdown)

meta.sub <- read.csv(paste0(loc,"/Data/metadata_no_age_corection.csv")) # If I re-run everything I won't need this, but for the moment I will.
rm.meta <- which(names(meta.sub) %in% c("Meeting_or_reference","G.short","G.Species","Manage.short","Area.broad","Area.long","Area.narrow","Stock.short","Stock","Model","Case","Notes","Area"))
meta.4.tab <- meta.sub[,-rm.meta]
re.ord <- c(10,3:8,11:12,9,2)
meta.4.tab <- meta.4.tab[,re.ord]
# Simplify the management orgs.
meta.4.tab$Management[grep("ICES",meta.4.tab$Management)] <- "ICES"
meta.4.tab$Management[grep("TRAC",meta.4.tab$Management)] <- "TRAC"
meta.4.tab$Management[grep("NEFSC",meta.4.tab$Management)] <- "NEFSC"

names(meta.4.tab) <- c("Stock", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species", "Minimum Age", "Maximum Age", "First Year", "Final Year","Location"," Management Body")

```


\newpage

```{r tab-meta,echo=F}
# Now make the table for the differences
csas_table(meta.4.tab,caption ="Summary of the stocks included in this analysis.  The minimum and maximum ages were obtained from original stock assessment output. AFSC is the Alaska Fisheries Science Center, TRAC is the Transboundary Resources Assessment Committee, DFO is Fisheries and Oceans Canada, NEFSC is the Northeast Fisheries Science Center, and ICES is the International Council for the Exploration of the Sea")
```
